plan: An elusive fish assassin who dodges your spells by hopping onto his trident.
aSurveiller: His R (Chum the Waters). A fish latches onto you then a shark bursts out: when it's attached, move away from your allies.
contrer: Wait until he has used his E before casting your spells: he dodges them by hopping.
When the fish from his R is attached to you, move away from your allies so you don't drag them in.
Poke him early: he is weak before level 6.
forces: Very hard to hit thanks to his E.
Huge single-target damage with his R.
Takes less damage from every attack.
faiblesses: Vulnerable once his E is used.

sorts.P: Passes through units and reduces damage taken.
sorts.W: His attacks cause bleeding; the next one hurts more.
sorts.E: Hops onto his trident, untargetable, then lands or hops again.
sorts.R: Fish that latches on, then a shark that knocks up.

momentFort: Very weak at levels 1 and 2. Dangerous from level 6, then even more with his Zhonya's Hourglass.
